evidence.computation: Whole rectangular spacing cells: floor(row length in inches / plant spacing) times floor(bed width in inches / row spacing). Proved spacing-cell area does not exceed bed area.
assumptions: One full spacing cell per plant, with no border plants, paths or staggered layout.
For a nonsquare bed with unequal spacings, the question must name the side along which rows run; otherwise the request declines.
Dimensions are nonnegative and both spacings are positive.
untrusted: English recognition, physical dimension and row-role parsing, and JSON framing.

evidence.computation: Exact expected seed requirement, or the least whole seed count whose expected stand meets the target; sufficient and minimal under the stated germination fraction. Total seeds and seeds per acre are separate request scopes. Fertilizer grade-column mass balance preserves total versus per-acre scope and applies a separately supplied area only when converting those scopes.
assumptions: Germination percentage is in (0,100] and target stand is nonnegative. This gives an expected stand, not a guarantee of realized germination.
Whole/minimum purchases and total seed counts use integer ceiling; ordinary per-acre seeding rates retain the rational expectation.
One target and one germination percentage are supplied, with explicit compatible total or per-acre scope. Hectare conversion and mixed total/area questions are withheld.
Fertilizer grade columns are N, P2O5 and K2O percentages in [0,100]; amount and total area are nonnegative, while division by area requires a positive area.
One grade and one nutrient/product amount are bound. Elemental phosphorus/potassium, hectare conversion, and conflicting multi-observation requests are unsupported.
untrusted: Shared exact numeric tokenization, English target/germination roles, quantity scope, model applicability and framing.

evidence.computation: Adds supplied macronutrient energy using general Atwater factors4/4/9/7 kcal per gram. All component amounts must be nonnegative; explicit all-zero amounts give zero. Explicit calorie label portions scale the Atwater sum by the requested/reference extent; grams and serving counts retain separate dimensions until a serving-mass declaration connects them.
assumptions: The question asks for the sum of supplied macronutrient amounts; unlisted macronutrients contribute zero to that sum, as displayed in the response.
Food-specific factors, label rounding, serving-count conversion and medical dietary advice are outside this model.

Explicit macro label amounts belong to the stated reference portion. Requested grams or serving counts scale that reference; converting between them needs a supplied positive serving mass. This is the general Atwater model, not food-specific digestibility or label-rounding adjustment.
untrusted: Shared exact numeric tokenization, English macro quantity roles, model applicability and framing.
